Recognizing early developmental differences can help children access support and interventions sooner.

Common early signs may include:

Square Breathing (Box Breathing): A Simple Technique for Panic Attacks

When anxiety or panic starts to rise, square breathing can help slow your breathing and calm your body’s stress response.

⬜ Step 1: Breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds
⬜ Step 2: Hold your breath for 4 seconds
⬜ Step 3: Breathe out slowly through your mouth for 4 seconds
⬜ Step 4: Hold your breath again for 4 seconds

Repeat this cycle for 1–3 minutes or until you feel calmer.

Why it helps:
During a panic attack, breathing often becomes rapid and shallow. Square breathing encourages slow, controlled breaths, which can reduce physical symptoms such as a racing heart, dizziness, and feelings of panic.

Remember: Panic attacks are uncomfortable but not dangerous. Controlled breathing can help your body regain a sense of balance and control.

When anxiety or panic starts to rise, square breathing can help slow your breathing and calm your body’s stress response.

⬜ Step 1: Breathe in through your nose for 4 seconds
⬜ Step 2: Hold your breath for 4 seconds
⬜ Step 3: Breathe out slowly through your mouth for 4 seconds
⬜ Step 4: Hold your breath again for 4 seconds

Repeat this cycle for 1–3 minutes or until you feel calmer.

They not only help your child, they help the parents also by making them understand what exactly the spectrum is and how we as parents can help our children . Unfortunately i was not able to continue here as i had to shift to other city with my family but they have helped my son alot and me too as a parent. Thank you ICGC for making me understand that Autism is not a disability instead your child is unique and special.
As a parent if you are looking for therapy center..ICGC IS BEST!
Thank you Dr. Anushka and ICGC TEAM.❤️

featured_reviews.name: Renuka Swami
featured_reviews.review_text:
My child is 7 year old. I visited icgc 3 years ago.I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team for their support and guidance in my child’s developmental journey.

Dr. Vaishali has played a crucial role in helping my child make significant progress in understanding and daily living skills. Thanks to her efforts, he is now almost independent and shows internal motivation in his day-to-day activities. She has also guided me thoroughly with the home program, making it easier for me to work with my child effectively.Her insights have been incredibly helpful.

Dr. Rachel has been instrumental in helping me understand my child’s challenges and the appropriate activities required to support his growth.

Dr. Manjiri Deshpande Ma’am is always available and supportive whenever we need assistance. Her willingness to help at any time is deeply appreciated.

The reception team, especially Kajal, has been very approachable and accommodating with scheduling and payment arrangements. Her support has made the process smooth and stress-free.

featured_reviews.name: Mohammed Teberez Sha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our child has been seeing Vaishali Madam for many months for occupational therapy support related to autism, and our experience has been a blend of both positive outcomes and some challenges.

On the positive side, Vaishali Madam has a calm and patient demeanor, which we found especially helpful in the early stages when our child was still adjusting to the therapy setting. She clearly has experience working with children on the spectrum and used a variety of sensory tools and strategies that did help our child build some foundational skills. The sessions were structured, and we appreciated the consistency in the routine, which our child thrives on.

In summary, Vaishali madam has professional skills and clearly cares about parents.

Now i have enrolled my kid for Speech therapy and Group therapy expecting a similar kind of support from Bhavna madam and other team mates.

Once again thank you Vaishali Madam for your efforts and patience assisting our son.

I look forward to similar support from the team ICGC for my son's other therapies.
